change_note: Ordinary recall inspects each record fully, then redacts credential and sensitive mapping entries and secret-bearing keys, replaces secret-bearing strings with a fixed marker, and only then truncates structured leaves to the UTF-8 serialization budget. Declared locator slots retain exact canonical UUIDs atomically with their record or relationship; identical strings in ordinary prose still redact or clip. A synthesis-owned source_locators list retains exact canonical source_document_id maps in supplied order, including repeats, atomically with that synthesis record. Explicit sensitive-field names apply to declared locator roles; a denied required role suppresses its owning record or relationship instead of emitting a partial set. A denied declared source_document_id role suppresses the complete synthesis owner. Supplied required locator IDs reject null. Off-record raw or serialized hits drop the whole record and its locators, including source_locators. No automatic-capture path or generated-ID entropy exemptions apply. Continuation never echoes queries, filters, keys, snippets, or fingerprints.

does_not_apply_to: deployed hook, CLI, MCP, or OpenClaw adapters
scope.guarantee: Best-effort nested redaction and structured truncation for ordinary recall. This unit alone does not protect deployed retrieval.

count_semantics.redaction.fields: Mapping entries removed because of credential-like names, additive sensitive names, or secret-bearing keys. Nested content inside a removed entry is not counted separately. Declared locator roles denied by additive sensitive names count here and suppress their owning record or relationship. Each denied declared source_document_id role on a synthesis source_locators member counts here once and suppresses that complete synthesis owner.
count_semantics.redaction.values: String leaves replaced by the fixed redaction marker. The whole string is replaced; secrets are not cut into a prefix.
count_semantics.redaction.records: Whole records omitted because an off-record indication appeared in the raw or serialized policy view.
count_semantics.truncation.omitted_items: Records, object members, or array members dropped to satisfy the byte budget. Off-record redaction is counted under redaction.records instead. A retained record or relationship keeps its declared locator set whole, or that record or relationship is omitted. A retained synthesis keeps its declared source_locators list whole, or that synthesis is omitted.
count_semantics.truncation.omitted_characters: Unicode code points removed from kept string leaves. Omitted items do not add their lengths here. Locator UUID strings are never clipped.
